title: Noir week, iv
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. The case, such as it is: a missing thing. The trench coat searches the bedroom. The missing thing is under the bed. It has four legs and is not drawn.

panels.composition: The bedroom drawn as a crime scene: the bed, the corkboard as evidence wall, a flashlight beam. The TRENCH COAT with the flashlight.
panels.caption: Something was missing. I'd known it since Monday. I hadn't wanted to look.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a small bedroom drawn as a noir crime scene with a flashlight beam crossing a corkboard covered in pinned papers, a man in a trench coat holding the light

panels.composition: The flashlight on the floor. Under the bed: two eyes. Nothing else drawn.
panels.caption: It was under the bed. It had been under the bed the whole time. Things usually are.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a flashlight beam on a bedroom floor revealing two small eyes glinting in the dark under a bed, nothing else visible

panels.composition: The trench coat kneeling. The hat off, at last, on the floor. The face, for the first time this week: Wood's.
panels.caption: I took the hat off. You can't do this in a hat.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a man in a trench coat kneeling beside a bed with his hat set on the floor, his face visible for the first time, looking under the bed

panels.composition: The trench coat lying flat on the floor, arm under the bed, up to the shoulder. The caption box empty — drawn, with nothing in it.

characters.pose: flat on the floor, arm under the bed

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a man in a trench coat lying flat on a bedroom floor with his arm reaching under the bed up to the shoulder, an empty caption box in the corner
image.notes: The caption box is drawn and empty. The genre gives up here; Friday the dog walks in.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: The case: the dog. The hat off. The empty caption box.
